Method (Dataset & Population): Dataset: NHANES 2011-2014, wrist-worn 80 Hz accelerometer dataset. U.S. population: 14,534 participants, aged 3+ years. Method: CHAP posture model and SWaN sleep model.
Notes: Uses machine learning to directly estimate sitting probability. Calibrated to match mean self-reported sleep duration.

Method (Dataset & Population): Dataset: NHANES 2003-2004, hip-worn ActiGraph minute-level accelerometer dataset. U.S. population: 6,329 participants, aged 6+ years. Method: intensity threshold of <100 cpm.
Notes: Represents 54.9% of monitored time. Non-wear time was excluded and average monitor wear time was 13.9 hours/day.

Method (Dataset & Population): Dataset: NHANES 2001-2016. U.S. population: children, adolescents, and adults. Method: self-reported total sitting time questionnaire.
Notes: Adult estimate reflects the 2015-2016 cycle; sitting time increased over time in the questionnaire data.
